messages:
Ravi (AE): BetaCorp POC: bulk ingest + re-rank pipeline started throwing 429s at 10:05 PT. They say it was fine earlier.
Tess (SRE): which route? embeddings or completions? any request id?
Ravi (AE): embeddings first, then a few completion reranks. Example response: HTTP/1.1 429 {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","reason":"per_route_capacity"} 
Jorge (Solutions): Dashboard shows per-route cap for /v1/embeddings was hit. Tenant=bcorp-77 quota=1200/min per_route=1000/min burst=2000.
Tess (SRE): Log snippet: 2026-03-21T17:05:12Z rate_limiter WARN tenant=bcorp-77 route=/v1/embeddings action=reject tokens=1050 window=60s per_route_cap=1000
Tess (SRE): Also seeing token_burn spike for streaming tasks: accounting: stream_tokens=600 nonstream_tokens=480 total_counted=1080
QuotaBot: Quota update requested for bcorp-77: +1000 tokens/min for 3 hours. Approver=finance@redwood.ai
Ravi (AE): Customer asks if we can remove per-route cap briefly. They worry about extra charges.
Billing (Finance): Temporary increases will be billed as usage; we can apply credit on a case-by-case. Ping with reason and AE sign-off.
Jorge (Solutions): Short-term mitigation: recommend batch embeddings (concat multiple docs per input) and reduce parallelism to 8. Also suggest disabling per-item completion streaming and use non-streaming rerank.
Tess (SRE): Hypothesis: per-route cap plus separate global token budget leads to early 429s when embeddings + streaming completions run. We have a race in accounting where streaming backpressure increments both per-route and global paths. Filing INF-4801.
Ravi (AE): Can we get a soft bump now so customer can finish evaluation? They want to complete two remaining imports.
Tess (SRE): Approved temp bump +1000 tokens/min until 2026-03-21T20:00:00Z. Noted as billable. Creating ticket to revert after window.
Jorge (Solutions): Sending customer a config snippet: ``POST /v1/embeddings {"input": ["..."], "batch_size": 64}`` and "Set X-Streaming: false for rerank calls"
Ravi (AE): Customer did the config change and re-ran import. No 429s observed in next 20 minutes.
Tess (SRE): Will monitor for 2 hours. Root cause tracking: accounting double-write on streaming path. Next: patch to dedupe accounting entries and add e2e test for embeddings+streaming.
Ravi (AE): Thanks team — I'll update BetaCorp and confirm billing preference. :white_check_mark:
